max_links_per_page caps the number of links enqueued from a single page

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"max_links_per_page\":2,\"max_pages\":10,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
